steps.text: Underground Ruins

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: This is... Rhodes Island Operator...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Repeat... This is Rhodes Island Operator Absinthe... and Operator Rosa.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: About two and a half hours ago, we got separated from our team during a Catastrophe evacuation in the Ursine borderlands and fell into a sinkhole...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Currently, we have no casualties. The coordinates of our last position are...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Do you read me? Come in.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I still can't reach anyone.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Maybe I should try another spot—
What are you doing standing up?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You should sit down and rest. Your leg...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Natalya.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: You've been gone thirty minutes. Have you found anything?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Unfortunately, no. I haven't found anything that will help us out of here.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: But you're right. It's a naturally-formed karst cave further in. The light is shining down from above on a much deeper part of the hole, and not in a straight line.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: We can't leave through the cave, and the opening above is too far up. We probably won't be able to escape without help.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Sounds like it's more or less the same situation as here. Okay, thanks for checking.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: No need to thank me!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: On the contrary, I should be thanking you.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: That reminds me, Absinthe, are you feeling better? How is your wound?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I learned some first-aid procedures when I worked in the Logistics Department. I can check if the bleeding has stopped and change your bandages.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I'm okay...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Don't be so quick to turn me down. You are injured because you helped me, and you guided me out of the areas affected by the aftershocks. This much is nothing.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: The east side's evacuated. No more civilians in the area!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: The last family at the bottom of the hill has gotten away. We don't have much time. We need to get out as soon as we can, or the Catastrophe—

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: —Watch out!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Absinthe!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Hold on tight!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Ugh... Ah.
Absinthe groans at the intense pain in her leg, but she quickly manages to bring her breathing under control and forces herself to shift her attention to her surroundings.
Her glimpse into the darkness yields no information whatsoever.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I can't see very well.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: There will be aftershocks. We need to move to a safer location.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Ugh—my light sticks aren't here... Ro... Natalya! Can you hear me?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Natalya?
Absinthe takes her hand. Her palm is still warm. Fortunately, the two of them are still together despite the fall.
However, Rosa is not responding.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Is she out?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: The stench of blood... and it's sticky... She's bleeding from her head.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: A head injury...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: We need to move somewhere bright enough that I can see.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: (Lightly knocks on the fallen wall)
A hollow echo can be heard through the collapsed walls and beams. It causes the chaos in her head to dissipate. She closes her eyes and blinks. Slowly, her vision starts to clear.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Come on, come on... At least take me somewhere safer.
Absinthe props up her unconscious friend and starts moving in the direction of a faint glow.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I did what I was supposed to do.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Any other Rhodes Islander would've done the same. All I did was help my teammate to a space that's more structurally sound to buy ourselves time for a rescue... It's standard procedure.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Besides, like the wound on your head, my leg injury isn't serious. It's just a flesh wound, my bleeding has stopped. And I don't have any broken bones. There's no need for first aid.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Really, it's nothing.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Then... what about the comms?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I still haven't been able to reach anyone outside.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Besides, we don't have much battery left. We can't keep it turned on the whole time in hopes of catching a signal. We'll have to try again later.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Is there anything else I can do right now?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: All we can do is wait.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: If there's something you want to ask, go right ahead.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Is it that obvious?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I'm just wondering... the mother and child who lived at the bottom of the mountain... the ones we evacuated last... Did they really get out safely? The earthquake came so suddenly...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Also, if we really can't reach anyone, what are we going to do?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: First, before I regrouped with you, I made sure they evacuated to safety.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Second, if we can't reach anyone on our own, they'll notice we're missing when they take a head count and send a search team.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: This is all standard procedure. Just like I told you before.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Have you always been so dependable?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: What do you mean...?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You're very dependable. It's like no hardship can slow you. I don't think I'd know what to do, if I'd ended up here by myself.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I'm sure you'd be fine.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Why is that?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Remember Chernobog? If you really didn't know what to do, how would you have gotten out of that place, that situation, alive?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: This can't compare to that.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: How did you—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Oh, right. I forgot you're from Chernobog, too.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Of course. I did things I'm not proud of in order to survive, but I did get a lot of help from the others.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: That's exactly why I don't understand why you came back.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Care to elaborate?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: You could've gotten out safely, but you chose to come back and help us evacuate the villagers who refused to leave.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Operators without search-and-rescue experience should've evacuated with the crew before the Catastrophe came instead of staying. If I wasn't able to save you, or if we don't actually make it out of this place...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Everything you did to stay alive and everything everybody did to help you will have been for nothing.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: That's true, but... if I always choose to leave, I'll always be the inexperienced rookie, won't I?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I'll always be stuck in the same place, never able to help more people.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I want to be like the rest of you and do more... That's also why I chose to work out here on the front lines instead of staying with Logistics.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: You can't let that push you into danger before you're ready.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: You have to treasure your own life.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: (Whispers) Seriously, what would the people who helped you, even gave their lives for you, say about this...?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Care to elaborate?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Never mind.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You didn't finish. Why?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Just leave it. This isn't something I should be worrying about. I shouldn't have said anything.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: It's been some time already. Let me find another spot and try the comms again.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: This is Rhodes Island Operator Absinthe and Operator Rosa. I repeat, this is Rhodes Island Operator...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Maybe hold it up higher?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I'm trying—

steps.name: Intermittent Voice
steps.text: —Probe—

steps.name: Intermittent Voice
steps.text: —*buzz*—

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Hello? This is Rhodes Island Operator Absinthe and Operator Rosa! We got separated from our team during a Catastrophe evacuation in the Ursine borderlands and fell into a sinkhole!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Our last known position is—

steps.name: Intermittent Voice
steps.text: —*buzz*—

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Hello? Do you read me? Our last known position is 61.700.20.450—

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Hello?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Gavno! We'd finally got a signal...!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: If we got a signal, that means there are others nearby.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Let me take the communicator inside the cave. I might get a better signal where the light is shining through from above.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: The cave... Let's go together.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: But what about your injury?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I told you. I'm fine.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Given the circumstances, we should stick together.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Let me help you. It'll be easier on your leg...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I'm good.
Absinthe lightly shakes her head and avoids the hand reaching out to her.
The girl before her is strong enough to lift a massive siege weapon. Of course she could help a lightly injured Absinthe up.
Accepting her help to move forward would be the most reasonable choice right now. However, for some reason, Absinthe is unwilling to take it.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I said I'm good.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Hm, alright.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Now then, let's go.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: This way...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I found this place when I was following the edge to see if I could find a path out.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Look, a stone block that's just the right size for standing on. It'll get us a little closer to the source, although there's still some distance from the top.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: In any case, wait here for a moment. I'll simply climb up—

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Be careful—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: —Right! Please hand me the communicator.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Do you remember the coordinates?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Certainly, very clearly.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: But... Hm? How do I turn this on? It looks somewhat different from the ones I've used before.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Oops... I modded that one myself.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: The channel's tuned. Press the rectangular button on the bottom to turn it on.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Hello?

steps.name: Faint Voice
steps.text: —*buzz*—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I can hear something! Does that mean I've got a signal?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: There is definitely a signal. Now give your report like I taught you.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: A—Alright.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: This is Rhodes Island Operator Absinthe and Operator Rosa. We got separated from our team during a Catastrophe evacuation in the Ursine borderlands and fell into a sinkhole...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Our last position is 61.700.20.450.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Repeat, our last position—

steps.name: Fuzzy Voice
steps.text: Hello?

steps.name: Fuzzy Voice
steps.text: Do you read me? This is—

steps.name: Fuzzy Voice
steps.text: —Catastrophe Messenger—Hello?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: If you can hear them, say yes, and repeat the coordinates.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Yes, we can hear you! This is Rhodes Island Operators Absinthe and Rosa. We need assistance. Our last known position is 61.700.20.450!

steps.name: Fuzzy Voice
steps.text: —Roger—

steps.name: Fuzzy Voice
steps.text: Stay where—

steps.name: Fuzzy Voice
steps.text: —Wait—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I... Sorry, I couldn't hear what he said in the end.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: It's okay.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: As long as you gave them the coordinates, you're halfway there.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: We should head back to where we were. It's more structurally sound there. The two aftershocks didn't damage it much. It'll be safer for us to wait for rescue.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: The transmission got cut off again. The Catastrophe likely hasn't passed.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: The most important thing right now is to make sure we're safe until the rescue team gets here.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Judging by the time, they should be here soon. I left a marker where we first stopped.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Do you see a red cloth?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I don't, but I have two light sticks here. Let's light them up.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Give me one.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: No, we'll save it for later. We don't know when exactly the rescue will get here. Let's not use up our resources before then.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: And I remember it should be around here...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: —Aftershock! Gavno!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Absinthe, you—

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Stay there! Get down, and put your hands on the back of your head!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Do it!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: *cough*!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: The damage isn't serious, but...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: It blocked off the light source. The pipes and beams probably didn't get damaged any—

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Natalya?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Natalya, what's wrong? Can you hear me?
The only response she gets is the settling dust and the sound of someone's slowly intensifying breathing.
*huff*...
*whimper*...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Hey, I can hear you. Here, give me your hand.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Oh, you're holding a light stick. That's good.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: You...

a.text: In the faint glow, Absinthe sees the other girl still bracing herself, curled up not too far away.
There is some rubble and dust on her back, but she is apparently unwounded.
The wailing just now could not have been her.
...Right?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Ugh... Ahhh...!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Natalya!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Wow, you're shaking a lot. Where are you hurt?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I can help you—ugh—the rescuers will be here soon. Hang in there!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: —Kill me—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Just kill me!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Does it... does it hurt that bad? Why would you say that?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Please... I beg you... help me...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I need to know where you're hurt to help you, but you keep avoiding me. I can't—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: *whimper*...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Natalya.

a.text: Absinthe grabs and holds the girl curled up on the ground. Finally, the girl lets go of her head and raises it to stare up into the darkness.
What is going on with her? A large number of questions are bombarding Absinthe's brain.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: What's...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: ...wrong?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I... No... No—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Please... I beg you... Don't leave me here...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I won't leave you behind. Ever.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: So, tell me—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: If you don't tell me anything, how am I supposed to help you?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I can't see. I can't see!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I can't see anything...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: You can't see...? Are your eyes hurt? Or maybe your head? Is there a blood clot pressing against your nerves?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Stay still and don't move. I need to see—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: No...

a.text: The girl keeps murmuring deliriously. There are no reflections of anyone in her eyes. It is easily noticeable if Absinthe raises the light stick to take a better look.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Your eyes don't look like they're focusing, but there don't seem to be any new wounds on your head...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Are you hurt anywhere else? What caused this?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Slow down. Tell me as clearly as you can.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: No? Why not?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Look at what I'm saying...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I think...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Maybe you should just kill me.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Kill me...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Why do you keep saying that?!

a.text: Absinthe takes a harsh step back. The dust trembles violently in the air, just like her emotions.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Was everything... everything we talked about a lie?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: You said you wanted to live and help even more people. That was a lie?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Yes, it was!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: So kill me already! The same way you set that fire!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Rather than suffering through life like this, I'd rather die a quick death. Just like the people who died because of me. They...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: They wouldn't want me to live. You don't need me to live either, do you?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Just take that axe of yours and give me a good chop right here...

a.text: Absinthe watches the girl forcefully slide her hand across her neck. She cannot stop her in time, and the light is too dim for her to check if the girl is hurt.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Just like that. It'll be quick.

a.text: Absinthe doesn't understand any of this. She thinks she can hear something slowly fracturing, even if that's practically impossible in this moment.
There is nobody else here. The fracture could only form between the two of them.
Amid the silence, Absinthe walks up to Rosa and sits her upright.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I ask only this one thing.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: And you won't even grant me that?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I don't know what's going on with you, but I heard what you said, and I can't pretend I didn't.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Your life isn't yours alone, and neither is mine.

a.text: Her sanity keeps her from saying what she wants to say. However, the very next second, she casts her sanity aside.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Our lives belong to those who are forever left behind.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I'm begging you...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Too many people died in Chernobog. Did you ever read the after-action report? I did. Even though I could never count all the tiny names written on that list, I still counted them over and over...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I found Uncle Valery's name, and... I found my father's name.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: He went to Peterheim, and he lost his life there.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I don't know what exactly happened. I could only guess and keep watching Peterheim survivors like you, to try to get an answer... to...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: What are you...?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: ...to what exactly my father gave his life for. What was there in you that was worthy of his sacrifice?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I want to know. I need to know...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: But I don't have an answer! I haven't been able to find it—that's why I was going to give up, until you—

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Until you moved from Logistics to the front lines and showed up on a mission like this, all of a sudden...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I thought you'd begun to move forward, but have you, actually?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: No. You haven't.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Kill me...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Enough of that! I'm not going to kill you! If you've made your choice, then how come you—

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: How come you still don't cherish your life?!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I'm begging you...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: If you really want to die, then fine. After we get out of here, when no one is looking, you'll have lots of ways to go about it—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Kill me, Sonya.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: —Suit yourself...?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Just... kill me.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Don't... Don't leave me alive in this place...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: There's... nothing here.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: 'Sonya...'

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: That's not my name. Where—

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Where do you think you are right now? Chernobog? Peterheim?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: You...

a.text: Absinthe finally understands everything. She keeps quiet, and snaps the last light stick to activate it. Then, she asks a question that will go unanswered.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: If... If you haven't gotten over your trauma, why did you apply to come to the front lines and put yourself in danger?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Couldn't you have guessed...?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: ...that things might get this ugly?

a.text: Absinthe grasps Rosa's arm. She squeezes tightly, and then as tight as she can to burn the heat of her palm in.
Thanks to this sudden, painful grasp, the panicking girl suffers an intense jerk.
She blinks.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: ...Where...?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: ...Where am I?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Is this what the school cafeteria... looked like?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: No, I don't remem—

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: You're not in Chernobog anymore.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Where am I? Who are you?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: You are somewhere underground. I'm Rhodes Island Operator Absinthe.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Underground? Why?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Because you want to save more people.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Right now, we need to find a way out of this place. If you can hear me, close your eyes and follow me. Take a deep breath.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I'll get you out of here.

a.text: Absinthe takes a deep breath and answers as such.
At first, the panicking girl does not understand the meaning behind this action, but after Absinthe repeats it again and again—
Finally, she slowly starts to move.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: *huff*...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: *phew*...

a.text: In that small space, the sound of their breathing is deafening.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Huff—Ugh—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: How are you feeling now?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Uhh... Absinthe...?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: What... happened to me?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Was I crying? Why...? I'm so sorry about that...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: It's okay. It only took a little time. We should try contacting the outside again.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: This is Rhodes Island Operator Absinthe and Operator Rosa. Our last position is 61.700.20.450.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Repeat... This is Rhodes Island Operator Absinthe and Operator Rosa.
Huh? There seems to be a transmission coming in—
Hello? Hello?
This is the Rhodes Island Catastrophe Rescue Team. Please report your coordinates—

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: We got through...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Our last known position is 61.700.20.450. I recommend checking the fallen plate to the west.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: There are two of us. We're... hanging in there.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Na... Rosa, knock on the steel pipe next to you, use the beat I taught you before.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Two light knocks, one heavy one... Like this?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Right.
The coordinates and the rescue signal we got earlier are a match... The infrared detector shows... Th—They're close by!
—Hello? Can you hear us?
If you can hear us, use the frequency just now and knock on the steel pipe to answer us—
Help has arrived.
Absinthe looks up to the source of the voice, as Rosa continues to knock on the steel pipe repeatedly.
There's someone here! Right around the coordinates we got! Should be them—
Hold on, we'll get you two out right away. Stay put and don't move...
If you read me, knock on the pipe!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: (Knocks)
Okay, okay.
Hold on—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: *huff*...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You're hurt. You should get rescued first.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I'm in better shape. I'll be fine.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Okay.
Even though she has long known that the joy of surviving a precarious situation is not nearly as intense as the books make it out to be, Absinthe nonetheless feels a sense of bewilderment.
Below clouds spreading through the skies like wildfire, she takes in the fleeting emotions like a breath.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Confirming Operator Absinthe's condition... Initial Diagnosis: Minor injuries. Rescue successful.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Please rest up and don't do anything strenuous. Once we rescue Operator Rosa, we'll help you with your leg—

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: —Operator Absinthe?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Let me help.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: What? You shouldn't be movin—

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Huh? Absinthe? Your injury—

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Give me your hand. I'll pull you up.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Operator Rosa.
